simple.summary: שְׁמַם (shᵉmam) means be astonied. First listed occurrence: Dan 4 16.

definitions.full: H8075. shemam [ שְׁמַם ] verb Ethpo`l. be appalled ( ᵑ7 (rare); see Biblical Hebrew; Christian-Palestinian Aramaic , Schulth 209 ); — Perfect 3masculine singular אֶשְׁתּוֺמַם (K § 36 ) Dan 4:16 .
